info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Relationship API
info.description: The Corporate Relationship API provides essential functionalities for accessing and managing corporate relationships within the banking domain. This API allows financial institutions to retrieve detailed information about existing corporate partnerships, facilitating better decision-making and relationship management. Typical consumers of this API include banking professionals and financial analysts who require quick access to relationship data for reporting and analysis purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can enhance their understanding of corporate interactions and improve their service offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details of corporate relationships, including relevant data and attributes associated with them. Use this endpoint to retrieve comprehensive information necessary for managing corporate interactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving corporate relationship information. This body should carry the necessary parameters to specify which corporate relationships to fetch and any additional filters if applicable.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, returning the corporate relationship data.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method, specifically leveraging JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure API access. Clients are required to include a valid JWT token in the Authorization header of each request, facilitating secure and stateless authentication.
